semantics.live_delivery: Task events are published to the in-process broker before TaskEventRecord SQLite commit. SSE receive latency therefore measures live broker delivery, while AgentExecutor callback time includes the persistence callback cost.
semantics.browser_paint: This v1 benchmark terminates at SSE client receipt. Browser React state update and paint are intentionally not claimed yet; they require frontend-side Performance API instrumentation.
